subject: ela
intro: Identify figurative language and its meaning.

items.prompt:
'He was as brave as a lion' is a:
A) simile
B) metaphor
C) idiom

'The wind whispered through the trees' is:
A) personification
B) a simile
C) a fact

steps: Human action for wind. Key is A.

items.prompt:
'The classroom was a zoo' means it was:
A) full of animals
B) wild and noisy
C) very quiet

'Her words were a knife, cutting deep' means her words were:
A) sharp objects
B) very hurtful
C) helpful

steps: Metaphor for pain. Key is B.

items.prompt:
'The stars danced in the sky' is an example of:
A) a simile
B) personification
C) an idiom

steps: Stars given a human action. Key is B.

items.prompt:
'He has a heart of stone' means he is:
A) very kind
B) unfeeling/cold
C) made of rock

Read.

'The old house groaned and sighed as the wind pressed against it.'

This uses personification to make the house seem:
A) brand new
B) alive and weary
C) invisible

steps: Human actions suggest life/age. Key is B.

items.prompt:
'Life is a roller coaster' is a metaphor suggesting life:
A) is only at amusement parks
B) has ups and downs
C) is always smooth

steps: Roller coaster = highs and lows. Key is B.
